1.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
1.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, See, I have made thee as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

2.web: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
2.asv: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee; and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

3.web: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
3.asv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

4.web: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, and I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
4.asv: But Pharaoh will not hearken unto you, and I will lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth my hosts, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

5.web: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh, when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.”
5.asv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Jehovah, when I stretch forth my hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

6.web: Moses and Aaron did so. As Yahweh commanded them, so they did.
6.asv: And Moses and Aaron did so; as Jehovah commanded them, so did they.

7.web: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
7.asv: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

8.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
8.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

9.web: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, that it become a serpent.’”
9.asv: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Show a wonder for you; then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, that it become a serpent.

10.web: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
10.asv: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so, as Jehovah had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

11.web: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.
11.asv: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers: and they also, the magicians of Egypt, did in like manner with their enchantments.

12.web: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
12.asv: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

13.web: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them; as Yahweh had spoken.
13.asv: And Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Jehovah had spoken.

14.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
14.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn, he refuseth to let the people go.

15.web: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he goes out to the water; and you shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him; and the rod which was turned to a serpent you shall take in your hand.
15.asv: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink to meet him; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thy hand.

16.web: You shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness:” and behold, until now you haven’t listened.
16.asv: And thou shalt say unto him, Jehovah, the God of the Hebrews, hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou hast not hearkened.

17.web: Thus says Yahweh, “In this you shall know that I am Yahweh. Behold, I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
17.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, In this thou shalt know that I am Jehovah: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in my hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

18.web: The fish that are in the river shall die, and the river shall become foul; and the Egyptians shall loathe to drink water from the river.”’”
18.asv: And the fish that are in the river shall die, and the river shall become foul; and the Egyptians shall loathe to drink water from the river.

19.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood; and there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
19.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thy hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood; and there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.

20.web: Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahweh commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
20.asv: And Moses and Aaron did so, as Jehovah commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

21.web: The fish that were in the river died; and the river became foul, and the Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river; and the blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
21.asv: And the fish that were in the river died; and the river became foul, and the Egyptians could not drink water from the river; and the blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

22.web: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments; and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them; as Yahweh had spoken.
22.asv: And the magicians of Egypt did in like manner with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Jehovah had spoken.

23.web: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.
23.asv: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he lay even this to heart.

24.web: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink of the water of the river.
24.asv: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

25.web: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.
25.asv: And seven days were fulfilled, after that Jehovah had smitten the river.
